<thought>Based on the DIBAL‑H reduction of a carboxylic ester to an aldehyde and an aliphatic alcohol, the generic retrosynthetic step breaks the ester into its corresponding aldehyde and alcohol. For a simple ester such as ethyl acetate (CCOC(=O)C), the precursors are acetaldehyde (CC=O) and ethanol (CCO). This pair represents the possible precursors produced by applying the identified template.</thought>
<final_answer>[['CC=O', 'CCO']]</final_answer>
